title: Roost
description: Produce&Hatch eggs without terrible lag from chickens.
body:
# Dependency You need to install the [Nutlet](https://modrinth.com/datapack/nutlet) Datapack first in order to correctly create the multiblock structure machine for this datapack.
# Cotent Add recipe for transfer three type of egg to each other.
See the in-game advancements to get more info.
Add 2 Multi-block machine :
- "PL Roost": produce eggs. - "Chicken Incubator": hatch eggs.
